_comment: Offline stand-in for OSV/VDB. Keys are the purls sbomcmp queries (pkg:golang/... with the v prefix). IDs are real advisories for these versions; severities bucketed. 'mcp' is keyed by the MCP server's launcher package purl.

pkg:npm/qs@6.11.0.summary: qs vulnerable to prototype pollution via __proto__ in query string

pkg:npm/follow-redirects@1.15.3.summary: Improper input validation in follow-redirects URL handling

pkg:npm/axios@1.6.0.summary: Axios cross-site request forgery vulnerability (XSRF-TOKEN leak)

pkg:pypi/werkzeug@3.0.1.summary: Werkzeug debugger vulnerable to remote execution when interacting with attacker controlled domain

pkg:pypi/jinja2@3.1.3.summary: Jinja xmlattr filter accepts keys with non-attribute characters

pkg:golang/golang.org/x/net@v0.10.0.summary: HTTP/2 rapid reset can cause excessive work in net/http
Improper rendering of text nodes in golang.org/x/net/html

pkg:golang/golang.org/x/crypto@v0.17.0.summary: Terrapin prefix truncation in SSH (fixed in this version; listed for demo)

pkg:npm/requests-toolkit-pro@1.2.0.message: no such name on the npm registry; nearest real package is 'requests-toolkit'. Names like this get registered by squatters

pkg:npm/%40modelcontextprotocol/server-f.riskNotes: Can write to the host filesystem.

pkg:pypi/mcp-server-browser.riskNotes: Executes a headless browser; exec scope added 2026-09.
